bio.text: Khaleel M. Anderson represents District 31 in Queens in the New York State Assembly; his official biography says he was first elected in November 2020.
He was born in Brooklyn and raised in the Rockaways, according to that biography.
The biography says he graduated from Queens College and previously served on Queens Community Board 14.
